page: Microsoft Azure E64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv6 server family. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading. It operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. The server is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPUs, though it is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64s_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core processing and top-tier memory performance. Uncached large-block memory bandwidth read and write speeds rank in the top 10% of tested systems, facilitating rapid data transfers. Multi-core performance is highly competitive, as evidenced by top-tier scores in Geekbench multi-core tests and Passmark database operations. Additionally, the processor's support for Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 instructions contributes to strong performance in LLM inference tasks and cryptographic operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E64s_v6 offers a dense memory profile and high-frequency dedicated compute resources without the added cost of bundled local storage. This makes it an efficient choice for memory-intensive workloads that rely on external Premium Storage. The server is suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching, high-throughput static web serving, and enterprise-grade data processing tasks.
